title: Servicing Fee on Retention Statements
content:
## Statement servicing fee — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the statement servicing fee enters the retention statement balance. It is read from the loan's record under the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) product.

| HECM servicing fee option | HECM rate type | Statement servicing fee |
|---|---|---|
| monthly fee with set-aside | monthly adjustable | the monthly-adjustable servicing fee of the HECM's payout plan for each fee month still to post |
| monthly fee with set-aside | annual adjustable or fixed | the annual-or-fixed servicing fee of the HECM's payout plan for each fee month still to post |
| included in rate | any | nothing |
| (Summit loan) | — | nothing |

**Fee months still to post.** The whole calendar months from the first day of the latest accrual period among the posted HECM servicing fee entries on the loan to the statement date; a loan with no posted servicing fee counts 0 months.

*Hypothetical:* a monthly-adjustable HECM with a monthly fee option whose payout plan fee is taken as USD 30.00 for the illustration, latest posted fee for the March accrual period (first day 1 March) and a statement dated 20 June, counts 3 fee months: USD 90.00.
